synopsis: On the outside, Lu Meihe appears to be a strict boss, dubbed "The Cobra" by her subordinates, but she nurses a soft spot for her intern Lin Wenjing. As she has a reputation to maintain, she is confined to expressing her feelings within the pages of her personal notebook... only for Lin Wenjing to discover it! Since then, Lu Meihe realized that despite her mild manners and soft-spoken attitude, Lin Wenjing was really anything but! synopsis: Kinoshima Rocketry Club casually uploaded a vlog of a test firing of their hybrid engine. The engine exploded — blowing away their dream of reaching space with it — but that wasn't the only thing that blew up in that video.
